title: First-mile Orbit Playbook and KPI Compass
body:
Purpose:
This working playbook helps product ops coordinate the ‘first-mile’ launch window for medium-risk feature releases (beta → limited GA). Focus: clear KPI definitions, discrete decision gates, and a compact runbook for the first 72 hours post-traffic.

Scope and intended use:
- Audience: product ops, release engineer, on-call owners (SRE), solutions eng, and PMs.
- Applies to releases with rollout traffic up to 500k requests/day or those that touch model serving, routing, or billing flows.
- Not for infra-only patches; use SRE runbooks for infra-only changes.

High-level milestone timeline (example):
- T-28d: Activation plan & KPI deck locked (owners assigned)
- T-14d: Canary/QA pass and smoke-test matrix green
- T-3d: Communications + playbook rehearsal with oncall
- T: Launch (phased 5%-50%-100% over 3 days)
- T+1: First 24h telemetry review + tactical fixes
- T+3: Post-launch debrief & KPI sign-off or rollback decision

KPI compass (primary signals we’ll watch):
1) Success rate (user-facing): definition = 1 - (user error responses / total user requests). Target: >= 99.5% during rollout.
2) P95 latency (ms): definition = 95th percentile end-to-end request latency. Target: < 350ms for latency-sensitive routes.
3) Token throughput per GPU: definition = total tokens served / GPU-hour. Target: baseline + expected uplift <= 1.25x cost delta.
4) Cost per 1k tokens (estimated): definition = infra cost / (tokens/1000). Alert: > +30% vs baseline triggers cost review.
5) Model output regressions: % deviation from golden prompt set using eval harness. Threshold: >3% degradation triggers immediate rollback candidate.
6) Observability health: missing spans/logs >1% of requests = degraded; requires SRE investigation.

KPI collection method and owners:
- Telemetry streams (prod-metrics cluster): p95, error rate (owner: Ethan Marshall)
- Billing/cost extract (billing-job daily): cost per token (owner: Lucia Gomez)
- Eval harness runs (nightly): regression delta (owner: Samir Rao)
- Traces/log completeness check (on-call SRE): (owner: Tara Nguyen)

Decision gates (go / slow-roll / rollback):
- Gate 0 (pre-launch sanity): all critical smoke tests pass, tracing enabled, canary traffic green. If any fail -> delay.
- Gate 1 (0→5%): If Success rate < 99% or P95 > 500ms or regression > 5% in golden prompts -> immediate 5% rollback to previous model and widen canary window for debugging.
- Gate 2 (5→50%): If cost delta > +50% or error rate increases by absolute 0.5pp vs baseline -> pause rollout and triage.
- Gate 3 (50→100%): Only proceed if rolling 48h window meets targets and no open high-priority regressions.

Rollout knobs and quick fixes (operational cheatsheet):
- Traffic throttle: reduce traffic to previous stable percentage (owner: release-eng)
- Route split: divert to fallback model variant (owner: platform-eng)
- Feature flag: flip off new scoring/augmentation pipeline (owner: product-ops)
- Quantization fallback: switch to higher-precision model snapshot if quality drop persists (owner: applied-ml)

Communication & on-call cadence:
- Pre-launch 48h huddle: daily 09:00 PT standup with PM, SRE, release eng, product ops.
- Launch day: hourly pulse during 0→50% expansion, 4-hourly after 50%. Post-mortem invite sent at T+72h.
- Slack channel naming: #launch-first-mile-[feature] (owner: Priya Kapoor).

Runbook: first 72h checklist (owners + acceptance criteria)
- [ ] T-24h: Confirm canary config and code hashes in deploy summary (owner: release-eng). Acceptance: hashes match release PR.
- [ ] T-4h: Smoke test run with synthetic traces (owner: SRE). Acceptance: no new 5xx and tracing samples contain model id.
- [ ] T: Start 5% traffic. Monitor 30m. (owner: product-ops). Acceptance: success rate >= 99.5 and p95 < 500ms.
- [ ] T+6h: Evaluate golden prompt run and regression metrics. (owner: applied-ml). Acceptance: regression <= 3%.
- [ ] T+24h: Cost delta check and infra saturation scan. (owner: finance-eng). Acceptance: cost delta <= +30% and no GPU saturation warnings.
- [ ] T+48h: Decide full expansion or rollback. (product-ops + PM + SRE). Acceptance: all KPIs within thresholds and no unresolved P0s.

Contingency playbook (if things go wrong):
- Immediate triage channel: gather logs, recent PRs, explainers from model/infra owners.
- Quick rollback: revert to tagged stable image and drain new model instances. Notify customer success if public customers are impacted.
- Partial fallback: route a subset of traffic to a conservative model variant + ramp up caching.

SLO/Alert thresholds to wire before launch (sre checklist):
- rate.slo.user_success < 99% sustained for 10m -> paging SRE
- latency.p95 > 600ms for 5m -> paging SRE + product-ops alert
- tracing.missing_spans_rate > 1% for 30m -> create incident ticket

Post-launch retrospective prompts (T+72h):
- What surprised us (ops or product)?
- Were KPIs realistic vs assumptions?
- Which rollout knobs worked and which were too blunt?
- Owner action items (who will change what before next release).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the golden prompt set under 100 prompts — quick to run but representative across locales.
- Don’t over-index on single metric; watch coupled signals (latency + error + regression).
- If SRE suggests longer canary, accept — early caution saves time.

Appendix: quick links and artifacts
- Confluence: first-mile-orbit runbook (link in linked_artifacts)
- JIRA epic: JIRA-8782 (release epic)
- Relevant PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412

Status log (short history):
- 2025-11-05: Draft created (Priya)
- 2025-11-12: Added evaluation thresholds and decision gates (Samir)
- 2025-12-02: Rehearsal notes added; updated owners for telemetry (Ethan)

Open questions:
- Do we have a cheap synthetic load generator for token throughput measurements at 5% traffic? (action: release-eng)
- Is finance-eng comfortable with the 30% cost delta threshold for auto-pause? (action: Lucia)

If you’re editing: leave comments inline and add a `last_modified` line at document end.

--end of working playbook (first-mile)
